lines.gurmukhi: ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਕਦੇ ਮੂਲਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਭੰਡਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: tot na aavai kade mool pooran bha(n)daar ||
lines.translation: There is never any deficiency at all; the Lord's treasures are over-flowing.

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਬਸੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: charan kamal man tan base prabh agam apaar ||2||
lines.translation: His Lotus Feet are enshrined within my mind and body; God is inaccessible and infinite. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਸਤ ਕਮਾਵਤ ਸਭਿ ਸੁਖੀ ਕਿਛੁ ਊਨ ਨ ਦੀਸੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: basat kamaavat sabh sukhee kichh oon na deesai ||
lines.translation: All those who work for Him dwell in peace; you can see that they lack nothing.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਭੇਟੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਪੂਰਨ ਜਗਦੀਸੈ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)t prasaad bhete prabhoo pooran jagadeesai ||3||
lines.translation: By the Grace of the Saints, I have met God, the Perfect Lord of the Universe. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੈ ਜੈ ਕਾਰੁ ਸਭੈ ਕਰਹਿ ਸਚੁ ਥਾਨੁ ਸੁਹਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: jai jai kaar sabhai karahi sach thaan suhaaiaa ||
lines.translation: Everyone congratulates me, and celebrates my victory; the home of the True Lord is so beautiful!

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਪਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਸੁਖ ਪੂਰਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੩੩॥੬੩॥
lines.transliteration: jap naanak naam nidhaan sukh pooraa gur paaiaa ||4||33||63||
lines.translation: Nanak chants the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the treasure of peace; I have found the Perfect Guru. ||4||33||63||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਆਰਾਧੀਐ ਹੋਈਐ ਆਰੋਗ ॥
lines.transliteration: har har har aaraadheeai hoeeai aarog ||
lines.translation: Worship and adore the Lord, Har, Har, Har, and you shall be free of disease.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਚੰਦ ਕੀ ਲਸਟਿਕਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਮਾਰਿਆ ਰੋਗੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: raamacha(n)d kee lasatikaa jin maariaa rog ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: This is the Lord's healing rod, which eradicates all disease. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਪੀਐ ਨਿਤ ਕੀਚੈ ਭੋਗੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur pooraa har jaapeeai nit keechai bhog ||
lines.translation: Meditating on the Lord, through the Perfect Guru, he constantly enjoys pleasure.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਕੈ ਵਾਰਣੈ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਸੰਜੋਗੁ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: saadhasa(n)gat kai vaaranai miliaa sa(n)jog ||1||
lines.translation: I am devoted to the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy; I have been united with my Lord. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਬਿਓਗੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis simarat sukh paaeeai binasai biog ||
lines.translation: Contemplating Him, peace is obtained, and separation is ended.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਜੋਗੁ ॥੨॥੩੪॥੬੪॥
lines.transliteration: naanak prabh saranaagatee karan kaaran jog ||2||34||64||
lines.translation: Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of God, the All-powerful Creator, the Cause of causes. ||2||34||64||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਦੁਪਦੇ ਘਰੁ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: raag bilaaval mahalaa 5 dupade ghar 5 ||
lines.translation: Raag Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl, Dho-Padhay, Fifth House:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਵਰਿ ਉਪਾਵ ਸਭਿ ਤਿਆਗਿਆ ਦਾਰੂ ਨਾਮੁ ਲਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: avar upaav sabh tiaagiaa daaroo naam laiaa ||
lines.translation: I have given up all other efforts, and have taken the medicine of the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਾਪ ਪਾਪ ਸਭਿ ਮਿਟੇ ਰੋਗ ਸੀਤਲ ਮਨੁ ਭਇਆ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: taap paap sabh mite rog seetal man bhaiaa ||1||
lines.translation: Fevers, sins and all diseases are eradicated, and my mind is cooled and soothed. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਆਰਾਧਿਆ ਸਗਲਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਗਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur pooraa aaraadhiaa sagalaa dukh gaiaa ||
lines.translation: Worshipping the Perfect Guru in adoration, all pains are dispelled.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰੈ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਅਪਨੀ ਕਰਿ ਮਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: raakhanahaarai raakhiaa apanee kar maiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: The Savior Lord has saved me; He has blessed me with His Kind Mercy. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਾਹ ਪਕੜਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕਾਢਿਆ ਕੀਨਾ ਅਪਨਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: baah pakaR prabh kaadhiaa keenaa apanaiaa ||
lines.translation: Grabbing hold of my arm, God has pulled me up and out; He has made me His own.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਮਨ ਤਨ ਸੁਖੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਿਰਭਇਆ ॥੨॥੧॥੬੫॥
lines.transliteration: simar simar man tan sukhee naanak nirabhaiaa ||2||1||65||
lines.translation: Meditating, meditating in remembrance, my mind and body are at peace; Nanak has become fearless. ||2||1||65||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰੁ ਧਰਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਥਾਪਿਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਨੋ ਦਾਨਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: kar dhar masatak thaapiaa naam deeno daan ||
lines.translation: Placing His Hand upon my forehead, God has given me the gift of His Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਫਲ ਸੇਵਾ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕੀ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਨਹੀ ਹਾਨਿ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: saphal sevaa paarabraham kee taa kee nahee haan ||1||
lines.translation: One who performs fruitful service for the Supreme Lord God, never suffers any loss. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਰਾਖਤਾ ਭਗਤਨ ਕੀ ਆਨਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: aape hee prabh raakhataa bhagatan kee aan ||
lines.translation: God Himself saves the honor of His devotees.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਚਿਤਵਹਿ ਸਾਧ ਜਨ ਸੋ ਲੇਤਾ ਮਾਨਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo jo chitavahi saadh jan so letaa maan ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Whatever God's Holy servants wish for, He grants to them. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਰਣਿ ਪਰੇ ਚਰਣਾਰਬਿੰਦ ਜਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ॥
lines.transliteration: saran pare charanaarabi(n)d jan prabh ke praan ||
lines.translation: God's humble servants seek the Sanctuary of His Lotus Feet; they are God's very breath of life.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਿਲੇ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਨ ॥੨॥੨॥੬੬॥
lines.transliteration: sahaj subhaai naanak mile jotee jot samaan ||2||2||66||
lines.translation: O Nanak, they automatically, intuitively meet God; their light merges into the Light. ||2||2||66||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ ਕਾ ਆਸਰਾ ਦੀਨੋ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: charan kamal kaa aasaraa deeno prabh aap ||
lines.translation: God Himself has given me the Support of His Lotus Feet.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਣਾਗਤਿ ਜਨ ਪਰੇ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਸਦ ਪਰਤਾਪੁ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: prabh saranaagat jan pare taa kaa sad parataap ||1||
lines.translation: God's humble servants seek His Sanctuary; they are respected and famous forever. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰ ਅਪਾਰ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸੇਵ ॥
lines.transliteration: raakhanahaar apaar prabh taa kee niramal sev ||
lines.translation: God is the unparalleled Savior and Protector; service to Him is immaculate and pure.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜ ਰਾਮਦਾਸ ਪੁਰਿ ਕੀਨੑੇ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: raam raaj raamadaas pur keenhe guradev ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: The Divine Guru has built the City of Ramdaspur, the royal domain of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਕਿਛੁ ਬਿਘਨੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: sadaa sadaa har dhiaaeeai kichh bighan na laagai ||
lines.translation: Forever and ever, meditate on the Lord, and no obstacles will obstruct you.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹੀਐ ਭਇ ਦੁਸਮਨ ਭਾਗੈ ॥੨॥੩॥੬੭॥
lines.transliteration: naanak naam salaaheeai bhai dusaman bhaagai ||2||3||67||
lines.translation: O Nanak, praising the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the fear of enemies runs away. ||2||3||67||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਰਾਧੀਐ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧ ਸਮਾਗੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: man tan prabh aaraadheeai mil saadh samaagai ||
lines.translation: Worship and adore God in your mind and body; join the Company of the Holy.

lines.gurmukhi: ਉਚਰਤ ਗੁਨ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਜਸੁ ਦੂਰ ਤੇ ਜਮੁ ਭਾਗੈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: ucharat gun gopaal jas door te jam bhaagai ||1||
lines.translation: Chanting the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe, the Messenger of Death runs far away. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਜੋ ਜਨੁ ਜਪੈ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਦ ਜਾਗੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: raam naam jo jan japai anadin sad jaagai ||
lines.translation: That humble being who chants the Lord's Name, remains always awake and aware, night and day.
